messages:
auditor (External): Hi team — auditor here. We need SOC 2 evidence for an incident: API latency spike + unexpected billing for customer ACME on 2024-08-05 ~14:22 UTC. Please provide: retention policy for API access logs, KMS/HSM key rotation records (key IDs, rotation timestamps), routing/fallback logs around the incident, a reproable set of steps (exact payload + concurrency) we can run, and the billing metering rows that show the spike. Also need an exported audit bundle and chain-of-custody.

sam (Support): Ping @maria @jonah — assigning this. Support ticket SUP-8421. Any quick pointers?

maria (Eng-Security): Thanks. We can pull: retention matrix PDF, keystore rotation CSV, S3 export sample of access logs, and routing policy snapshots. @jonah can you collect traces and latency histograms?

jonah (SRE): On it. I pulled trace ids from the timeframe: trace=abc123, abc124, abc125. Quick repro basics from runbook below. Will attach traces + p50/p95/p99 hist.

jonah (SRE): Repro payload (save to payload.json):
```
{
  "model": "redwood-large",
  "input": "summarize: user text...",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```

curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d @payload.json
```

sam (Support): Auditor also wants billing rows for July 24-31 and the 08-05 spike. @kevin can you add invoice snapshot + raw metering CSV?

kevin (Customer Success): Ack. I'll pull invoice PDF and metering export for ACME. Will redact PII. ETA ~2 hours.

maria (Eng-Security): KMS/HSM notes: rotation job run IDs: `rotate-2024-07-02` and `rotate-2024-08-01`. Keys used during incident: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/1234abcd-5678-ef00-1111-222233334444`. We'll include HSM audit fingerprints and signing cert chain in the bundle.

deploy-bot: Deploy `keystore-rotate` v2.1 succeeded at 2024-08-01T03:10:12Z on node-keystore-4

auditor (External): We need exact concurrency pattern to reproduce the latency and an explanation of how fallback routing impacted billing. Please give the exact `hey`/`wrk` command and token counts.

jonah (SRE): Repro command we used locally: `hey -n 5000 -c 50 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -D payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Notes: run for ~2 minutes to observe p95. Timeout set to 20s, and run with slight jitter.

maria (Eng-Security): Note: at ~14:26 UTC our smart routing triggered fallback to `model-small` for some requests due to host saturation. That change increased total tokens billed because model-small had different tokenization/response length for our prompt. We'll include routing-policy logs and the config snapshot at 14:20, 14:26, 14:40.

sam (Support): I'm assembling a single audit bundle: `retention_policy.pdf`, `keystore_rotation.csv`, `traces_abc123.tar.gz`, `billing_rows_ACME_2024-07-24_08-05.csv`, `routing_snapshot_2024-08-05.json`. Uploading to secure share: https://redwood-secure.example.com/audits/2024-08-05-ACME.zip (internal link)

auditor (External): Thanks. Please confirm chain-of-custody for that bundle and provide checksums (sha256). Also we need the control IDs and owners for retention/billing controls.

luis (Legal): Checksum sha256: `f3b2d9c4e0a9b8c7d6e5f1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890ab`. Exported by jonah at 2024-08-06T10:02:00Z, uploaded by sam at 2024-08-06T10:15:34Z. Permissions set to `auditor@auditfirm.com`, expiry 30 days. Signed manifest included.

sam (Support): :thumbsup: bundle uploaded and permissions set.

auditor (External): Received the bundle. One last ask: retention durations — policy shows 365 days for access logs and 90 days for request bodies, but we need the formal control ID + proof of automated deletion runs. Provide job logs for deletion.

maria (Eng-Security): Control owner: @maria (ENG-SEC). Control ID: `SEC-LOG-RET-03`. Deletion job logs included: `log-retention-run-2024-07-01.log` and `log-retention-run-2024-08-01.log`. We'll include screenshots of manual verification and the cron config lines.

auditor (External): Perfect. We'll review the bundle and follow up if we need more artifacts or replay access. Thanks all.

sam (Support): Leaving a note on SUP-8421 with links to the bundle and this thread. Closing the loop with ACME.
